data.title: 摩根 · 妖精国冬之宫
data.description: 【摩根 · 妖精国冬之宫】妖精国不列颠的冬之王座厅里，摩根端坐于黑蓝礼服之中，银色长发垂落王座扶手，冰蓝瞳孔俯视着臣服于她的土地——「冬之女王座下，万物皆以寂静为誓。」
data.action: 端坐高背王座，双手自然放在扶手上，目光平静地俯视大厅
data.camera: medium-full frontal shot, upright seated posture and throne arms visible
data.promptProse: Morgan sits upright on the Winter Palace throne, both hands naturally on its arms and her black-and-blue gown ordered across her lap. Crown and long silver-white hair frame measured attention directed down the hall. The frontal medium-full view places distant pillars behind the high back and wing-like sleeves. Cold daylight enters high windows, highlighting the ruff and sleeve edges while the layered skirt retains deep but distinct folds.
